Same city: Departure and arrival cities cannot be the same
Past date: Travel date cannot be in the past
Min 30 min ahead: Scheduled trips must depart at least 30 minutes from now — choose a later time or book a "leave now" trip
Quarter hour: Pickup time must be on a quarter-hour step (:00, :15, :30 or :45)
Active request exists: You already have an active trip request — cancel it or wait for it to finish before booking another
Max 30 days: Travel date cannot be more than 30 days ahead
Female only: Female-only trips can only be requested by female passengers
No active trip: You have no active trip at the moment
Trip not found: Trip not found or you do not have access to it
Invalid transition: This status transition is not allowed
Trip not active: Location updates are only allowed for active trips
No driver assigned: No driver has been assigned to this trip yet
No driver location: Driver location is not available yet
